summary: Character-class query that tests a character code against a broad printable-class bit set. In single-byte mode it masks the per-code classification table entry with 0x157; in multi-byte mode it delegates to the lookup-table conversion fallback with the same 0x157 (decimal 343) mask.

operations.description: Mode guard on the character-encoding state: when cbMultiByte <= 1 the code page is single-byte and the static classification table applies directly; otherwise the multi-byte conversion path is taken.

Single-byte path: read the classification table entry off_5E69C8[0][CharType] and keep only the bits selected by mask 0x157 (binary bits 0, 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8, spanning upper/lower/digit/punct/blank/alpha class bits).
Multi-byte path: delegate the classification to CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback, passing the character code and the decimal constant 343 (equal to 0x157) as the class mask.
Return the masked classification flags from the selected path.

unresolved: Broad-class interpretation of mask 0x157 is DERIVED from the mask value; the packet does not name the classification flags.
Proposed name follows the packet canonical name CharacterClassificationQuery.
LEGACY ABI name Character_Classification_Query is consistent with the canonical name but carries no stronger trust.
